title: Lebanese Spinach Falafel & Cos Salad Pitas
subtitle: with Mint Yoghurt & Sweet Potato Fries
description: Get a taste of Beirut with these golden falafel pita pockets, packed with crunchy cos and a refreshing mint yoghurt. We’ve paired them with some sweet potato fries for a crispy kick that makes this veggie feast a total winner.

steps.text:
•

• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. 
• Cut sweet potato into fries. 
• Place on a lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, then season with salt and 
pepper and toss to coat. Bake until tender, 20-25 minutes.  
TIP: If your oven tray is crowded, divide fries between two trays.

•

• Meanwhile, finely shred baby cos lettuce (see ingredients). Slice cucumber into 
thin rounds. Roughly chop tomato.  
• Pick and thinly slice mint leaves (see ingredients). 
• In a small bowl, combine Greek-style yoghurt and mint. Season to taste with salt 
and pepper. Set aside.

•

• When the fries have 10 minutes remaining, set your air fryer to 200°C. 
• Place spinach falafel in air fryer basket. Brush or spray with a drizzle of olive oil 
and cook until golden and heated through, 5-6 minutes. 
• Bake pita bread directly on a wire oven rack until heated through, 2-3 minutes.  
TIP: No air fryer?  In a large frying pan, heat olive oil (2 tbsp per person) over  
medium-high heat. When oil is hot, cook spinach falafel, tossing, until deep golden 
brown, 4-6 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.

•

• Halve pita bread and spread with some garlic sauce. 
• Halve the falafel (if preferred). 
• Fill pita with some cos, tomato, cucumber and falafel. Drizzle with mint yoghurt. 
• Divide Lebanese spinach falafel and cos salad pitas between plates. 
• Serve with sweet potato fries and any remaining salad. Enjoy!
